1. Insert tree id
```{r}
source("script/read_tree_inventory.R")
cityoi <- "NY"
df_tree <- read_tree_inventory(city = cityoi)

v_taxa <- c("Quercus", "Morus", "Ulmus", "Fraxinus", "Betula", "Acer", "Populus", "Vacant")
```

2. Creat buffer zone near tree point (sample points)
```{r}
library(sp)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

boundary_NY <- sf::read_sf('data/raw/NY/boundary/nybb_dissolved.shp')
coordinates(df_tree) <- c("lon", "lat")
point_tree <- st_as_sf(df_tree)

# randomly pick
set.seed(123)
sample_points <- point_tree[sample(nrow(point_tree), 5), ]
point_tree <- st_set_crs(point_tree, "EPSG:4326")

# Transform the data to a new CRS with explicit units
sample_points <- st_transform(sample_points, crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +units=m"))
st_crs(sample_points)

# Create buffer for height index
buffers <- st_buffer(sample_points, dist = 500)

# Visualize
ggplot() +
geom_sf(data = boundary_NY, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(40.5, 40.9), xlim = c(-74.3, -73.6)) +
  geom_sf(data = sample_points, color = "black", size=2, shape=17) +
  scale_color_manual(values="darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  geom_sf(data = buffers, fill = "white", color = "red")

```

3. Insert building data / Intersection fail (prelimilary result from Arcgis)
```{r}
building_footprint <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/NY_building_footprint/geo_export_56deb8a8-0463-4f00-8f45-99e751e3b8e1.shp') %>%
  st_make_valid(building_footprint)

buffers <- st_transform(buffers, crs = st_crs(building_footprint))
intersection <- st_intersection(buffers, building_footprint)

library(foreach)
library(progress)
library(sf)
library(doParallel)

cl <- makeCluster(min(5, detectCores()), outfile = "")
registerDoParallel(cl)
intersection <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(buffers), .combine = rbind) %dopar% {
  sf::st_intersection(buffers[i, ], building_footprint)
}

stopCluster(cl)
saveRDS(intersection, file = "/result/intersection_result_sample.rds")

```

4. building index for betula_200_buffer
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(foreign)

dbf_file <- "~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/NY_building_footprint/inter_buffer_200_betula.dbf"
intersect_200_bld_betula <- read.dbf(dbf_file)

#BCR_betula_200
bld_index_betula_200 <- intersect_200_bld_betula %>%
  group_by(tree_id) %>%
  summarise(BCR_betula_200 = sum(Shape_Ar_1) / (40000 * pi))

#BVD_betula_200
BVD_betula_200 <- intersect_200_bld_betula %>%
  group_by(tree_id) %>%
  summarise(BVD_betula_200 = sum(Shape_Ar_1 * heightroof) / (40000 * pi))

bld_index_betula_200 <- left_join(bld_index_betula_200, BVD_betula_200, by = "tree_id")

#BHD_betula_200
BHD_betula_200 <- intersect_200_bld_betula %>%
  group_by(tree_id) %>%
  summarise(BHD_betula_200 = sum(heightroof) / (40000 * pi))

bld_index_betula_200 <- left_join(bld_index_betula_200, BHD_betula_200, by = "tree_id")
write.csv(bld_index_betula_200, file = "~/phenology-urban/result/bld_index/bld_index_betula_200.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# sky view factor
#data prepare

betula_point_all <- point_tree %>% filter(str_detect(taxa, "Betula"))

set.seed(123)
betula_point <- betula_point_all[sample(nrow(betula_point_all), 10), ]


building_footprint <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/NY_building_footprint/geo_export_56deb8a8-0463-4f00-8f45-99e751e3b8e1.shp') %>%
  st_make_valid(building_footprint)

betula_point_sp <- as(betula_point, "Spatial")
building_footprint_sp <- as(building_footprint, "Spatial")

projection_crs <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=18 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
proj4string(betula_point_sp) <- projection_crs
proj4string(building_footprint_sp) <- projection_crs
building_footprint_sp <- subset(building_footprint_sp, !is.na(heightroof))

library(shadow)
svf_betula <- SVF(
  betula_point_sp, 
  building_footprint_sp,
  obstacles_height_field = "heightroof",
  res_angle = 10,
  b = 10,
  parallel = 4
)
saveRDS(svf_betula, file = "result/bld_index/svf_betula.rds")
```

5. visualize

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

betula_point <- point_tree %>% filter(str_detect(taxa, "Betula"))
bld_index <- read.csv("~/phenology-urban/result/bld_index/bld_index_betula_200.csv")
merged_data <- merge(betula_point, bld_index, by.x = "id", by.y = "tree_id", all.x = TRUE)

#plot buffer

boundary_NY <- sf::read_sf('data/raw/NY/boundary/nybb_dissolved.shp')
merged_data <- st_set_crs(merged_data, "EPSG:4326")
# Transform the data to a new CRS with explicit units
merged_data <- st_transform(merged_data, crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +units=m"))
# Create buffer for height index
buffers <- st_buffer(merged_data, dist = 200)

plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_NY, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(40.5, 40.9), xlim = c(-74.3, -73.6)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  geom_sf(data = buffers, fill = "white", color = "red")

ggsave("result/bld_index/buffer_betula.jpg", plot, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

# plot bld_index

plot_BCR <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_NY, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(40.5, 40.9), xlim = c(-74.3, -73.6)) +
  geom_sf(data = merged_data, aes(color = BCR_betula_200), stroke = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "BCR for Betula within 200m buffer") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno")

ggsave("result/bld_index/BCR_betula_200.jpg", plot_BCR, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

plot_BVD <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_NY, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(40.5, 40.9), xlim = c(-74.3, -73.6)) +
  geom_sf(data = merged_data, aes(color = BVD_betula_200), stroke = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "BVD for Betula within 200m buffer") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno")

ggsave("result/bld_index/BVD_betula_200.jpg", plot_BVD, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

plot_BHD <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_NY, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(40.5, 40.9), xlim = c(-74.3, -73.6)) +
  geom_sf(data = merged_data, aes(color = BHD_betula_200), stroke = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "BHD for Betula within 200m buffer") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno")

ggsave("result/bld_index/BHD_betula_200.jpg", plot_BHD, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

```

6. Correlation

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)
library(future)
library(foreign)
library(raster)
library(sf)

doy_NY_Betula <- readRDS("~/phenology-batchplanet/alldata/PSdata/doy/doy_NY_Betula.rds")

betula_2018_greenup_50 <- doy_NY_Betula %>%
  filter(year == 2018, direction == "down", thres == 0.5) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

bld_index <- read.csv("~/phenology-urban/result/bld_index/bld_index_betula_200.csv")
betula_200_bld_forstats <- left_join(betula_2018_greenup_50, bld_index, by = c("id" = "tree_id"))


lst <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/2018.tif")
extracted_values <- extract(lst, betula_point_all)
betula_point_all$lst <- extracted_values

betula_200_bld_forstats <- left_join(betula_200_bld_forstats, betula_point_all, by = c("id" = "id"))



# BCR ~ 50% greenup doy
# Create a ggplot with hexagonal bins
plot_function <- function(x_ind, y_ind, label_x, label_y) {
  plot <- ggplot(betula_200_bld_forstats, aes(x = x_ind, y = y_ind)) +    # change
    geom_hex(bins = 60, color = NA) +  
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightcoral", high = "darkred") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = label_x, y = label_y, fill = "Point Count") +               # change
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 20), axis.title = element_text(size = 22)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(x_ind)) +       # change
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty(y_ind)) +  # change
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", formula = y ~ x) +
    stat_poly_eq(aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., ..p.value.label.., sep = "~~~~")),
                 formula = y ~ x,
                 parse = TRUE,
                 label.x = "right", label.y = 0.9,
                 size = 4, color = "blue")
  
  ggsave(str_c("result/bld_index/",label_x, "_", label_y,".jpg"), plot, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
  
  }



plot <- plot_function(betula_200_bld_forstats$BCR_betula_200, betula_200_bld_forstats$lst, 
                    "Betula_BCR", "LST")

```
